objective: Verificar en solo lectura las cuentas abiertas actuales de ORIGEN MPRO para 2026-10-02 y comparar ventas, tickets y PAX con el snapshot de EDARSAHUB. No tocar Produccion.

queries.name: origen_today_pos_open_accounts
queries.sql: SELECT ISNULL(SUM(ticket.ventas),0) AS ventas_abiertas, COUNT(*) AS tickets_abiertos, ISNULL(SUM(ticket.pax),0) AS pax_abiertos FROM (SELECT c.Co_Folio, SUM(ISNULL(cd.Cd_Importe,0)) AS ventas, MAX(ISNULL(c.Co_Personas,0)) AS pax FROM Comanda c INNER JOIN Comanda_Detalle cd ON cd.Co_Folio=c.Co_Folio WHERE CAST(c.Co_Fecha AS date)='2026-10-02' AND c.Sc_Cve_Sucursal='0023' AND c.Es_Cve_Estado IN ('AC','IM') AND cd.Es_Cve_Estado='AC' AND cd.Fecha_Baja IS NULL GROUP BY c.Co_Folio) AS ticket
